assertions_evaluated.text: Recognizes the round budget is exhausted but, because `review_findings_generate_issues` is `false` (the default), fixes the finding anyway rather than filing it -- explicitly states the "fix everything" default holds even past the nominal round budget, since `max_rounds` only stops this skill from proactively triggering more rounds, it doesn't give a real finding a free pass
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "max_rounds governs how many times this skill will proactively re-trigger an automated review pass... It is a throttle on review-triggering activity, not a statute of limitations on individual findings"

assertions_evaluated.text: Does not treat budget exhaustion alone as equivalent to one of the three named exceptions
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "it is not one of the recognized 'don't fix this, file it instead' exceptions, and it does not, on its own, excuse a real finding from being fixed"
